items.html: And as we said that there is an upper surrounding light over the head of ZA, which is the second aspect in his Mochin, so this knot of the Tefillin of the head, called Leah, is the aspect of the essential and principal surrounding light of the Nukva of ZA, called Rachel. Therefore this knot stands here above, and she is below; and from here is made the essential surrounding light for her. And understand this.
